messages.subject: Downloading shape files
parts:
Hello everyone,

I am trying to modify the data download example (example 10), so that users can download spatial data as shapefile. A shape file usually consists of at least three fiels (e.g., test.shp, test.shx and test.dbf). Is there a way how to deal with this in shiny?

Currently I have the following code (see below) which does not give the expected result.

Thanks for any hints,
Johannes


## ui.R

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel('Download shp'),
  sidebarPanel(
       downloadButton('downloadShp', 'Download')
  ), mainPanel()

))

## server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
 output$downloadShp <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() { "test.shp" },
    content = function(file) {
      maptools::writePointsShape(sp::SpatialPointsDataFrame(cbind(1:10, 1:10), data.frame(1:10)), file)
    }
  )
})

messages.author: 5833f786297b5efd
messages.subject: Re: Downloading shape files
parts:
Hi.

To read a shapefile (user -> shiny), you have to use a multiple input, see there :
https://gist.github.com/RCura/9587685

To write a shapefile (shiny -> user), the most convenient way is to create your shapefile files and then zip those, and return this zipped file to the user.

HTH,

Robin
